contexts.text: Such an (unregenerate) man, when looked at from Heaven, appears like a black mass...
Whatever is proper to man... appears hard, as if it were bony, and black...
(These internals) had intensely black naked bodies.
A bier appeared shrouded with black cloths.
He became as black as an Egyptian mummy, in both face and body... SE 1262.
A certain black Spirit (was sent among the avaricious)... They said he was a robber because he was black.
There came robbers, who were intensely black...
There was a black Spirit (at the bridge)... SE 853.
Under Bandage, see this reference.

At first, as he supposed himself to be holy, he was seen in a bright human form... but was first turned into a dull blue, and then into black, and as he wanted to domineer over others and despised them in comparison with himself, he became blacker than others. SE 1302.
Under Colour, see these references. AR 915:2.
Black is man's Own Voluntary, or evil, which absorbs and extinguishes the rays of light.
Such... were seen by the ancients as black from the heat of cupidities, whence they were called Ham.
A beautiful girl appeared to me... in a becoming dress of glossy black... The black dress was the Word in the letter.
There appeared Spirits so black that I was horrified; they appeared in a black cloud. (They represented Christians at this day.)
There are some Gentiles from those regions where they are black, who... want to be treated severely...
They said that when they are being treated severely they are black, but that they afterwards put off their blackness, and put on whiteness; knowing that their souls are white, and their bodies black.
He with whom the outward man is opposite to the inward... has a spirit black and deformed...
Black signifies in general what is evil, specifically, the proprium of man, because this is nothing but evil. But what is darksome signifies falsity...
All the black cattle in the lambs () = proprium of innocence... Black = proprium. AC 4001.
Afterwards the column became entirely black... The black column signified the Voluntary which is utterly destroyed...
When (evil Spirits) are looked at by the Angels... some (appear) dusky and black like devils...
(This Spirit) was of a black colour in the light of Heaven; but he himself said that he was not black, but of a mouse colour. SE 874.
Hence the infernals appear in blackness and deformity inexpressible.
(One who) appeared as a black cloud...

There was a Spirit... who was permitted to pass over to a certain man... When he came thither, he said that he appeared to him as a black inanimate affair, or as a black mass without life. This was the corporeal life of that man... The corporeal life of a man who is in the good of faith... does not appear as black, but as woody, and of the colour of wood. SE 4060.
A certain evil Spirit was let into the state of the body... Then he also was seen by me as a black mass without life...
The black horse, and he who sat on it () = intellectual truth extinguished.
Falsities (seen represented) by black clouds.
A closed idea appeared like black points, in which there was not anything visible. SE 1188.
Under Beard, see this reference, and at AC 10754:end.
One kind (of Spirits from Jupiter) appear dusky, almost black...
To make a hair black () = to say that falsity is falsity from themselves... Black is predicated of what is false.
Their state then is that they are inwardly black, outwardly white...
There then appeared four kinds of men (in the fifth Earth)... (The last of the four were black ones.) AC 10757.
Under Beauty, see this reference.
Their interiors... were so closed that they appeared black... HH 481:2.
They who are corporeal loves appear gross, dusky, black, and deformed.
(The Papists) were cast into a sea, the water of which was black. LJ 61:7.
A black crust (was thus formed over that sea)... Instead of the sea there was black soil, under which was their Hell.
The Spirit whom they proclaimed as God became black...
They who were in the conceit of their Own intelligence were seen black.
The black horse () = the understanding of the Word destroyed as to truth in the third state of the Church.
An infant is born black from a black, or Moor, by a white or European woman...
In the light of Heaven satans appear like corpses, and some as black as a mummy; and devils appear duskily fiery, and some as black as soot.
Black is predicated of falsities, because it derives its origin from the darkness of Hell. AR 312, Illustrated.

Black colours derive their origin from Hell. There are two of them; one opposite to dead white; this blackness prevails with those who have falsified the truths of the Word; the other is opposite to red; this blackness prevails with those who have adulterated the goods of the Word. The latter blackness is diabolical; the other is Satanic.

I saw and lo a black horse () = the understanding of the Word destroyed as to truth, thus as to doctrine... The reason black = no truth, thus falsity, is that black is opposite to white, and white is predicated of truth. White also originates from light, and black from darkness, thus from the absence of light, and light is truth. But in the Spiritual World there is blackness from a twofold origin; one from the absence of flaming light, which prevails with those who are in the Celestial Kingdom; and the other from the absence of bright white light, which prevails with those who are in the Spiritual Kingdom. This latter blackness has a similar signification to darkness; the former to thick darkness. These blacknesses differ from each other; one is abominable; the other not so. It is the same with the falsities which they signify. In the abominable blackness appear those who are called devils; these also abominate truth as horned owls do the light of the sun. But in the blackness which is not abominable appear those who are called satans; these do not abominate, but are averse to truth, wherefore these may be compared to night-owls. AE 372, Illustrated. AE 401.
The sun became black as sackcloth of hair () = that with them all the good of love was adulterated... The reason is that in itself adulterated good is evil, and evil is black.
Black derives its origin from the shade (of love and wisdom), which is ignorance.
When he saw the Angels with me... he became black.
Evil is as black as ink...
The eyesight... is vivified by a colour which inwardly derives something from black, such as the colour green.
These robbers... are completely black, from head to foot. One of the same appeared to me, intensely black.

(The Spirits of Gehenna) hate what is black and shun it, but what is grey... namely, whiteness mixed with blackness, signifies justification from self... It is blackness which they shun, although it is in their whiteness...

They who believe themselves to be Christ... have black faces, and wear a hat made of rolls of black. They who acknowledge such to be Christ, wear a square black hat. Their bodies are black as from sweat which has black mixed with it.
On one bank of the lake were monsters of serpents, seen by me only as a black appearance. In the middle of the lake was blackness, mud rather than water. SE 1384.

A black colour is of such a nature as to absorb all the rays, and disperse them around in a disorderly manner. Hence the blackness. It is the same with wickedness, which is represented by a black colour; it absorbs all the rays of intellectual light, and diffuses them around without any order, so that at last nothing of light or of white appears.
There afterwards came out from the well as it were black spirits...

The form of the spirit (with the better sort of these Spirits of one of Jupiter's satellites) was shown as a black cloud, in which there was something human scattered... They said that they are white within. This blackness was then turned into a beautiful azure colour...
Under Proprium, see this reference.
Under Cloud, see this reference.
The Spirits (who spoke from me while I was asleep) had intensely black fingers without flesh, like the claws of a scorpion.
Black and horrible human forms (of magicians seen).
This murderer... seemed to fly like a black body.
A black spot seen under the left eye; a sign that they should desist...
This preacher... became black and fiery, his body being clad in white, and in this black and deformed condition was carried about and shown to Spirits and Angels...
Dippel seen with a black face...
(A Quaker Spirit turned from snowy to black, and made hard like a mummy.) SE 4083.
On a black horse.
Such were seen sitting on a large and noble black horse, but the horse was of ebony or marble, devoid of life as to its head, neck, and fore parts...

Other (evil Spirits) inspect various parts of the body... and where they see anything black, they know that proprium still reigns there, for man's proprium is black, because it is of self-love. They then examine what of self there is there... and then infuse their own thoughts, and lead wherever they will. LJPost 238.
Black horses () = the quality of the understanding as to truth in the beginning.
To be blackened like an oven () = to be in one's own evil from falsities.
The sun became black as sackcloth of hair () = that all good of love has disappeared.
The day shall grow black upon them () = thick darkness from Hell which blackens the understanding.
Under Blue, see this reference.

When this satan came into view, his face first appeared of a living white, then of a deadly pallor, and at last of an infernal black... Such are the successive states of the minds of those who are merely natural... The inmost things of their minds, being infernal, are represented in the face by the blackness...
